details: Tech: Spark (Scala), PySpark, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), ADLS Gen2, Azure DevOps, SBT
• Built scalable Azure-based data pipelines for ingesting and processing enterprise data using Spark, PySpark, and Azure Databricks.
• Ingested data in multiple formats (Parquet, JSON, CSV) using Spark on Azure Databricks with Spark table registration in ADLS Gen2.
• Developed orchestration pipelines in Azure Data Factory for full and incremental data loads.
• Implemented complex Spark transformation logic applying optimization techniques including partitioning, caching, and broadcast joins.
• Part of the architecture team for defining data structures; collaborated with client-side data engineering team on schema design.
• Collaborated with Product Owners, Architects, and Business Analysts to design end-to-end enterprise data flows.
• Implemented CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps for automated deployment and release management.
